verdicts.title: Transfers and Ladder tables hide the Sign/Sell buttons, the Price/Offer column and the Elo column on phones and tablets
verdicts.notes:
I reproduced this in my own worktree at c59a889 (derby/main) with /tmp/rt/screens-verify/out/transfers.cjs, transfers2.cjs and ladder.cjs. The save is level 99 and each script prints how many px of the first button or cell are visible inside .table-scroll.

Transfers:
- 390x844: Sell table scrollW 430-433 vs clientW 340; the first Sell button sits at left 387, past the box's right edge at 365, so 0 px of it shows. The Offer header is only 45 of 61 px visible. The market table is scrollW 372-390, and 23-41 of the 55 px Sign button shows. The number depends on the random name lengths.
- 360x740: Sell button 0 px, Sign 0.2 px.
- 768x1024: market scrollW 921 vs clientW 710. Price is at left 807 and Sign at left 877, both past the box right at 739, so neither is visible.
- 820x1180 (iPad Air): Price 0 px, Sign 0 px.
- 834x1194: Price 32 of 60 px, Sign 0 px.
- 1024 and 1280 are fine.
- .table-scroll has backgroundImage none, so there is no scroll hint.

Screenshots:
- /tmp/rt/screens-verify/out/shots/transfers-390.png: red Sign buttons cut to an 'S' sliver; the Sell column is absent; Offer cut to 'f105k'.
- /tmp/rt/screens-verify/out/shots/transfers-390-touch-dark.png: 'Sign' clipped.
- /tmp/rt/screens-verify/out/shots/transfers-768.png: market stops at DEF/'S'; no Price, no Sign.

The same root cause also hides the Squad table's Value column at 768: scrollW 902 / clientW 710, Value 0 px visible.

Ladder (smaller than claimed):
- Fits at 390 (Elo right 358 vs box right 365) and at 412.
- Clips 7 px at 375x667.
- Clips 29 px at 360x740, where Elo reads '13', '12', '9': /tmp/rt/screens-verify/out/shots/ladder-360.png.
- Clips 71 px at 320.
The ladder part alone would be minor.

Root cause, confirmed:
- src/client/styles.css:392-393 hides .tbl .opt only at max-width 600px, so the 7 attribute columns plus Nation/Age/POT return from 601 px up.
- The money cell and the action button are the last cells: src/client/ui.ts:300/304 (market) and 312/316 (sell).
- The Sell table's Age column (ui.ts:312) is not .opt, so it never hides.
- Each of the 7 columns carries 10px side padding (styles.css:380-382).
- Ladder P/W/D/L (ui.ts:362) are not .opt.

Fix:
- In styles.css, make the last column sticky: `.tbl td:last-child, .tbl th:last-child { position: sticky; right: 0; background: var(--surface); }`.
- Raise the .opt breakpoint to about 1000px, or hide only the attribute columns between 601 and 1000.
- Add the .tabs-style scroll shadows (styles.css:311-318) to .table-scroll.
- Cut .tbl td/th side padding to 6px below 600px.
- In ui.ts transfersScreen, mark the Sell table's Age th/td as .opt.
- In ladderScreen, mark P/D/L as .opt, or tighten their padding, so Elo fits at 360.

verdicts.title: Result dialog on phones: Elo, prize money, XP and the level-up flourish all sit below the fold, and the XP animation plays where nobody sees it
verdicts.notes:
I reproduced this with /tmp/rt/screens-verify/out/fold.cjs. It plays a 3 s-half ranked match on ?renderer=2d with xp=4470, so the match levels the club 9 to 10. Measured right after the dialog opens:
- 390x844: .rs-scroll bottom 702, then the sticky .rs-foot (702-835, 133 px tall: replay code plus 'Back to the club'). .rs-rewards top 636, Elo chip 682-728 (half hidden under the footer), XP card top 844, LEVEL UP tag top 951. scrollH 991 vs clientH 693.
- 375x667: visible bottom 525, rewards top 604. No reward and not even the 'Rewards' heading shows, so the dialog looks like it ends at Cards.
- 360x740: visible bottom 598, rewards top 667. Nothing shows.
- 412x915: the Elo chip shows; the XP card (top 812) is below 773.
- 1280x800 fits with no scroll (scrollH 588 = clientH 588).

Screenshots:
- /tmp/rt/screens-verify/out/shots/result-375x667-dark.png: hero plus stats only.
- /tmp/rt/screens-verify/out/shots/result-390x844-dark.png: the 'Rewards' heading plus a sliver of the Elo chip.
- /tmp/rt/screens-verify/out/shots/result-390x844-dark-scrolled.png: Elo +3, prize, sessions and the XP/LEVEL UP card, visible only after scrolling.

Animations: levels.css:76/80 run xp-fill(-up) from .45 s for 1-1.7 s. lv-pop starts at 1.35 s (levels.css:95) and xp-shine at 1.35 s (levels.css:105). Everything is over about 2.35 s after open. A player who reads the score and stats for more than 2.4 s before scrolling sees only the end state.

The impact is a bit smaller than claimed:
- After 'Back to the club' a separate level-up dialog still opens (main.ts:107-113), so the level-up itself is not lost.
- The new absolute Elo and the XP bar show in the header.
- The Elo delta, prize money and XP breakdown, the payoff the brief asked for, are hidden on every phone result.
Major is defensible, at its lower end.

Root cause: styles.css:667-670 (max-width 720px) stacks .rs-body to one column in DOM order, stats panel (ui.ts:488) before .rs-rewards (ui.ts:501). The 133 px sticky footer takes the rest of the height.

Fix:
- In the 720px block, `.rs-rewards { order: -1 }` with `.rs-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column }`, or collapse the stat bars under a <details>.
- Or add a compact strip to .rs-hero in resultModal (ui.ts:463-484): Elo delta badge, +XP, LEVEL UP.
- Start the xp-card animations in levels.css only once a class such as .is-visible is set. Set it from an IntersectionObserver on .xp-card after resultModal renders (main.ts render, or levels.ts).

verdicts.title: Training on phones and tablets: tapping a player seems to do nothing because his attribute panel is far below the fold
verdicts.notes:
I reproduced this with /tmp/rt/screens-verify/out/train.cjs (hasTouch, real tap on the 4th .roster-btn, level 99, 18-player squad).
- 390x844: before the tap scrollY 0 and .panel.trainee top 1074. The roster panel alone is 845 px tall. After the tap scrollY is still 0 and trainee top is still 1074 against innerHeight 844. The panel h2 changed to the tapped player, but the first Train button is at 1259 and the last at 1469. Focus stays on the roster button at y=406.
- 768x1024: trainee top 1043 > 1024 and first Train at 1163.
- 900x700 and 1280x800 use two columns and are fine (trainee top 192 / 142).

/tmp/rt/screens-verify/out/shots/train-390-after-tap.png shows the tapped 'Emeka Kemara' row inverted and nothing else changed: no attributes and no Train button on screen. A new phone player arriving at Training (unlocked at level 4, so early) sees only a list. Each player costs a tap, a scroll of about 900 px, Train, and a scroll back.

Root cause, confirmed:
- styles.css:655-656 stacks .training-grid to one column below 860px, roster first, following DOM order in ui.ts trainingScreen (around lines 323-345).
- main.ts:523-525 'trainee' only sets app.trainee and re-renders. It sets no pendingFocus and does no scroll, so restoreFocus leaves the user on the roster.

Fix:
- In main.ts case 'trainee', when matchMedia('(max-width: 860px)').matches, set pendingFocus to the trainee heading (give the h2 an id and tabindex=-1). After render(), call document.querySelector('.panel.trainee')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start', behavior: reduced-motion ? 'auto' : 'smooth' }).
- Better on phones, in ui.ts and styles.css: put the trainee panel first (`.training-grid .trainee { order: -1 }` in the 860px block) and make the roster a compact horizontal chip strip or a <select>, so the Train buttons stay on screen.
